notes.title: Chapter 2 News + Discord Server Annoucement
notes.notes:
Hey all!

So over the last month we have been working incredibly hard on Chapter 2 and we can confidently say it's around 20% done at this point in time!

The game still has a while to go however we want to start revealing bits and pieces about the second chapter. (Mainly the characters you'll meet this time around).

In Chapter 2 there will be 7 completely new characters that you will encounter, all you'll learn to love or hate!

Oh but you don't get to see them just quite yet dear reader! In due time I promise.
We'll be revealing each character of the game 1-by-1 very soon and we can't wait for you to see them!

For now I give you some screenshots from development!

We also want to quickly mention that we've created a discord server for fans of the to hang out in!
If you liked Your turn to Disembark and would like to chat to us then [url=https://discord.gg/tmPjCJpWbA]check it out here:[/url]

notes.title: Chapter 2 News + Thank you for playing our game!
notes.notes:
Hey all SquidoodleDev here!

First I wanted to say a huge thank you to everyone who has been playing our game and to those who left reviews on our steam page!

Every little bit helps and I am so happy so many people have enjoyed our game.
So far we've reached around 200~ people who have played our game on steam which is incredibly cool however we can't wait to see how many more will end up playing.

Now onto news, so for the first chapter I mainly worked solo with a little bit of narrative help from a friend however for chapter 2 I've formed a small dev team so that chapter 2 is bigger and more polished.

Our team name is [b]Relatable Anarchy[/b] and we can't wait to share our plans for the game going forward. We will post news here as development happens however development is a slow process and there are only three of us so bare with us!

The best thing you can do at the moment if you enjoyed the game is consider sharing it to friends or family so they can give it a try, all the support we can get is incredibly helpful!

Thank you!
- Relatable Anarchy
